speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: SIADH (Syndrome of Inappropriate Antidiuretic Hormone) secondary to small cell lung cancer.

The corrected electrolytes reveal severe hyponatremia (Na 122 mEq/L) with normal volume status and kidney function, which is the hallmark of SIADH. Given her significant smoking history and progressive confusion, this is highly suggestive of an underlying malignancy, specifically small cell lung cancer, until proven otherwise.
